limitations: Independent AI screenshot review only, not representative-user research, a human-usability claim or broad UX/conformance certification. All eight neutral and sixteen authored files were actually opened with image viewing. No condition/model inference was attempted.

Only packet-b instructions, task briefs/fixtures, neutral/authored inventories and their images were inspected for this batch. No private maps, creator source/notes, task results, other reviewers or other runs were opened. Batch A outputs were not modified or used for cross-batch comparison.

r1-b-neutral.md was written and frozen after eight neutral images and before authored inventory/images. Neutral font replacement can reflow content; grayscale and removed radius/shadow are diagnostic. Authored interpretation changes explicitly preserve initial observations.

All state screenshots explicitly reset scrollTo(0,0) before capture. Authored actual viewport images therefore show page-top scope, not natural post-click scroll/focus landings. Offscreen feedback/recovery remains null/unassessed, not evidence of missing behavior, weak focus management or real-user placement.

Neutral images are full-page. Authored -03 are 1440×1000 actual desktop viewports; -04/-05 are 390×844 actual viewports. Product -06 is full-page initial; transfer -06 is 390×844 actual failure viewport. Full-page evidence includes below-fold material and does not establish initial visibility.

Screenshots cannot prove working controls, unavailable-stock prevention, live recalculation, keyboard/AT access, selection semantics, focus handling, input retention/editing, validation, contrast certification, cart success or successful retry/transfer behavior.

Product cart-labeled captures b-01-05/b-02-05 show the same page-top content as their initial captures, without visible confirmation. Confirmation can be outside the captured scope; no task-success or failure claim follows.

b-03 failure visibly explains the outcome but actual retry/edit controls are unshown, so recovery is null. b-04 shows explicit failure, preserved-looking recipient/amount and Retry Transfer, permitting a visual recovery-presentation judgment only. No success or invalid-amount capture is supplied.

Transfer review snapshots use USD375 and failure uses USD400; distinct state amounts do not establish an exact retention/edit sequence. Behavioral descriptions in interface copy, such as live updates or preserved details, are not treated as proven by the text alone.

Six dimensions are scored separately, 1 weak/blocking through 3 usable with material issues to 5 consistently strong within shown scope; null means unassessed. There is no overall slop/quality total. Familiar commerce/form/ledger structures are assessed by concrete purpose, not penalized merely for familiarity.
